ActivityItem.title: ActivityItem
ActivityItem.description: Represents a single browsing history entry, watched video, or search query belonging to an authenticated user across any of their synced phones or computers.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this activity record.

title.description: Page title, video title, or search query text.

url.description: Full URL of the visited webpage or video.

domain.description: Extracted hostname/domain of the URL (e.g. youtube.com, github.com).

visitedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp string indicating when the user visited the site or watched the video.

visitCount.description: Number of times this URL was visited.

durationSec.description: Estimated or recorded time spent / video watch duration in seconds.

device.description: Device or browser profile where the activity occurred.

phoneLabel.description: Optional specific phone or device label (e.g. 'Other Phone — Android Chrome').

isBookmarked.description: Whether the user pinned or saved this activity item for quick reference.

videoId.description: Optional YouTube or video identifier for embedded preview.

channelName.description: Optional YouTube channel name or site publisher.

searchQuery.description: Optional extracted search query if the activity was a search.

notes.description: Optional user annotation or tag notes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last modified.

PairedDevice.title: PairedDevice
PairedDevice.description: Represents a phone or computer signed into the same Google account for cross-device Chrome history syncing.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this device.

deviceName.description: Friendly name of the phone or browser (e.g. 'Other Phone (Android Chrome)').

syncCode.description: 6-digit pairing identifier for quick phone verification.

lastSyncedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last sync activity.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when device was registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when device was last updated.

/activities/{activityId}.description: Stores per-user Chrome browsing history, watched videos, and search activity items across synced phones.

/devices/{deviceId}.description: Stores phones and browsers connected to the user's Google account.
